expert.name: Aino
expert.quote: Lapland in winter is quieter than anywhere I know. The snow swallows every sound and the sky does the rest.
expert.tip: Rent the thermal overalls your lodge offers for the aurora nights. Your own jacket will not be enough at minus twenty, however good it looks.

summary: Nine days from Helsinki to the top of Lapland: three nights in Rovaniemi for Santa Claus Village and the northern lights, whale watching from Tromsø, a night at Lake Inari and two nights back in Helsinki.
included: Included: all transfers and rail or ferry journeys as listed; sightseeing and cruises as listed with tickets where stated; daily breakfast.
